description: PDF & Abstract Table Audit — Extraction infrastructure assessment

critical_gaps.impact: Cannot map environmental features to outcomes
In DB but not in extractor output

notes: Extraction pipeline is production-ready for findings storage but INADEQUATE for theory-tier integration. Critical gap: architectural_variable extraction. Without it, BN cannot distinguish which environmental features drive which outcomes. Abstract parsing returns flat text, not structured claims.
issues_found: No architectural_variable field in any layer
Abstract parsing not structured (flat text only)
Effect magnitude not classified from effect sizes
Temporal dynamics extracted but not persisted to DB

changes_to_plan.change: Interface must handle MISSING architectural_variable gracefully

changes_to_plan.reason: These are partially available or inferrable but not guaranteed

recommendations_for_cx4.interface_design: Design ExtractedFinding with architectural_variable as Optional<string> with mapping_confidence
